newsitem.title: SPAIN: Aznar says new jobs to be created in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Aznar says new jobs to be created in Spain.

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar reiterated on Wednesday that new job creation remained a priority for the goverment and said he expected to see new employment opportunities in the future.

"The economic policy of the government is contributing in a relevant way to create new jobs in Spain...and in the future new jobs will be created," Aznar said in his opening speech in a debate on the state of the nation.

"The most important problem for the Spanish economy in recent decades has been its inability to create stable employment for all... The change in the direction of economic policy aims to steady (economic) growth and create jobs," he said.
Aznar stressed the importance of ensuring wage rises in line with gains in productivity.
"This is necessary so that we don't put at risk our growing international competition and creation of new jobs," he said.
Aznar proclaimed 1997 the "Year of the Job" earlier this year.
